name: Microfit Autobody Parts Supply
old_description: When purchasing auto body parts and mirrors, it's important to ensure compatibility with the make and model of your vehicle. OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) parts are designed specifically for your vehicle and offer the best fit and performance, while aftermarket parts may vary in quality and fitment.
about:
Microfit Autobody Parts Supply operates from Beltsville, Maryland, where it runs an e-commerce platform for auto body parts and mirrors. The company’s founding year, ownership structure, and founder names are not disclosed in public sources.

The business distributes replacement body panels, bumpers, mirrors, and related components for a broad range of passenger cars and commercial trucks. Its website features a year-make-model lookup covering more than 60 brands — from Acura, Chevrolet, and Ford to BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Volvo — as well as heavy-duty lines such as Freightliner, International, Kenworth, and Peterbilt. The catalog spans model years from the 1960s through 2024. Orders are processed through an online cart, and the company publishes a return policy that requires a Return Goods Authorization (RMA), proof of purchase, and accepts parts with intact CAPA seals within 10 days of invoice; parts with broken seals or that have been altered, painted, or damaged are ineligible.

Customers include collision repair shops, fleet maintenance operations, and individual vehicle owners seeking OEM or aftermarket parts. The extensive make-and-model coverage indicates a focus on the automotive and commercial vehicle aftermarket.

The company emphasizes fitment accuracy through its vehicle-specific search tool and a structured returns process designed to reduce incorrect shipments.
